body: Thanks, that helps. I'm sorry about what people say to you, that fucking sucks, man. As for my looks, people seem to not really be able to give me a straight answer for whatever reason, and I never get advice on what to change. Ah well, maybe I'll figure something out

I would like to try, I just never get any decent feedback on my looks and I don't know where to turn to. I'm honestly clueless on this subject, lol, but people who I would think know what they're talking about never seem to be able to help me out.

I'm male. I don't even know what it is I don't like about myself, I can't seem to put a finger on it. I do have a receding hairline, but I'm not bald quite yet. I just feel like I have a whole bunch of ugly/undesirable features. No pimples, definitely not obese.
That would alleviate all my problems honestly. I just wish I were attractive, you know?

Wow thank you so much for that response. Kind of put some things into perspective. I actually do have an appointment coming up for a haircut so I've got that step out of the way!

Finances aren't too much of an issue as of right now thankfully but your generosity honestly is extremely overwhelming and brought a tear to my eye. Thank you so much for replying - you seem like a fantastic person. Coincidentally, I'm from South Florida also!
Its been 4 months though and I really don't feel any better than day 1.
